settings.column_window: full width (7820) - tokeye.inference does not window

aemodes.rule: GO if pooled recall of annotated-active frames >= 0.70 at some occupancy threshold AND per-shot recall >= 0.5 on at least 80 % of the 180 shots at that threshold. Precision, AUROC and the unannotated fraction are reported but never fail the verdict.

tokeye.rule: GO if pooled recall of annotated-active frames >= 0.70 at some occupancy threshold AND per-shot recall >= 0.5 on at least 80 % of the 180 shots at that threshold. Precision, AUROC and the unannotated fraction are reported but never fail the verdict.
